description: This file is a shell script used for testing git's read-tree functionality, specifically testing two-way merge scenarios and related behaviors. It sets up test cases, performs git operations, and compares expected versus actual results.

methods.name: read_tree_twoway
methods.description: Performs a two-way merge of git trees specified by hashes and lists the files with their stage.

methods.name: compare_change
methods.description: Compares the current file against an expected output after sed transformations, used to verify merge results.

methods.name: check_cache_at
methods.description: Checks the status (clean/dirty) of a file in the git index at a specific path.
